From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-demo econ check-in & staggered credit plan

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation and some clear pilot goals. Quick recap and a proposal to unblock procurement and keep the pilot humming: 

Key points we agreed on during the call:
- Pilot scope: 30-day PoC across 3 storefront teams (search, recommendations, support snippets).
- Expected steady-state usage: ~4–6M tokens/day during peak test windows, with ~18M tokens on heavy ingestion days (weekend promos).
- Primary model candidate: Redwood-13B-quant (we also discussed a cheaper 7B-quant variant for higher-volume endpoints).

High-level unit economics (initial guidance):
- 13B-quant: target price band $100–$140 per 1M tokens depending on caching & quantization profile.
- 7B-quant: target price band $40–$70 per 1M tokens.
- With prefix/KV caching and request batching we commonly see 20–30% effective token reduction on search-style prompts; we used 25% for the numbers below.

Proposal: staged credit top-up to cover the pilot and align milestones (helps procurement sign-off without a large upfront commit)
- Initial top-up: $5,000 in trial credits (applies immediately to the hosted trial; covers ~50–70M effective tokens depending on model).
- Week-2 health check: provide an additional $5,000 if metrics look good (latency < 500ms p95 on search endpoints, model quality pass rate >= 90% on agreed eval set).
- Contingency hold: further $10,000 release can be approved if you move to a 3-month paid pilot or provide a PO covering anticipated consumption.

Attached: acme_usage_snapshot.csv (sample of daily token distribution from your demo trace) and a one-page proposed_staggered_credit_plan.pdf.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Confirm whether procurement needs a sample invoice/statement for the initial $5k credit (we can generate a proforma).
2) Confirm the daily volume range we should model for the health check (are the 4–6M peak numbers accurate?).
3) Point to your procurement contact to loop in for the PO/process.

If you prefer a single credit amount instead of staged top-ups, we can do $15k one-off and accelerate setup. I recommended the staged approach to reduce procurement friction.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min sync Monday to finalize paperwork.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Thanks, Karthik — clear summary and appreciated the staged approach. A few clarifying items from our side before we loop procurement:

1) Credits -> tokens: can you provide the exact conversion logic (do credits map 1:1 to dollars and then to tokens at the selected $/1M rate?) We need a short write-up to include with the PO.
2) Volume ask: the 4–6M peak is correct for the search team; recommendations will likely add another ~2M/day in steady usage. Total blended peak 6–8M/day.
3) Pricing pushback: our finance lead asked whether you can hit $95/1M tokens on the 13B-quant if we commit to a 10M/month baseline after the pilot. We understand model/latency trade-offs — is that feasible with a dedicated configuration?
4) Procurement contact: procurement@acme-retail.com (they asked for a sample invoice and preferred terms — net 30 is standard).

If you can send a short note on conversion + sample invoice we can start the PO conversation. Also please include any SLA exceptions for the trial.

Best,
Lina
Head of Product, Acme Retail

Lina — quick answers below and attached a sample invoice and a one-page conversion note.

Credits and conversion (short):
- Credits are issued as a dollar-denominated balance on your Redwood hosted account (so $1 credit = $1).
- Tokens consumed are billed against that balance using the per-model unit price you select for the pilot (e.g., $120 per 1M tokens).
- Effective tokens = raw tokens * (1 - caching_rate). For the demo trace we used a conservative 25% caching reduction.

On $95/1M for 13B-quant:
- We can consider $95/1M if you (a) commit to a 10M/month baseline for at least 3 months post-pilot, and (b) agree to use the 13B-quant config we operate in a dedicated slice (may require a short Dedicated trial ramp). I'm looping in Monica (SRE/ops) and Marissa (solutions) to validate latency SLOs and the dedicated configuration feasibility.

Attached: sample_invoice.pdf (application/pdf, 8KB) and conversion_note.txt (text) summarizing the numbers you can paste into your PO.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send a DocuSign addendum for the staged credit release if procurement is ok with staged funds + net 30 terms.
- Monica to run a short latency/throughput check and confirm whether we need to allocate a small dedicated slice to meet the $95 price condition.

If procurement gives the green light on the initial $5k, we’ll enable the credit in your account today and kick off the health check.

—
Karthik
